study_status: exploratory: cohort and earlier outcomes were already observed
target: finite full-profile empirical strict-majority uncovered set

data.sampler: nested multivariate hypergeometric over actual ballot multiplicities
data.tied_rank_rule: symmetric tie count T, no decisive win

folds.development: cyclic next source in original cohort source order

learning.empirical_bayes: single symmetric Beta(alpha,alpha) prior fit from full decisive counts of unique training profiles only; source-balanced, profile-balanced, then pair-mean composite Beta-binomial working likelihood
learning.empirical_bayes_supervision: full training counts supply richer prior-fitting information than Jeffreys and majority/membership-only neural labels; repeated resamples are not prior-fit evidence; inference uses observed counts only
learning.ordinary: ordinary membership head trained on full-profile UC labels
learning.relational: relational membership head trained on the same full-profile UC labels
learning.learned_edge: independent edge-orientation probabilities trained on full-profile majority labels with BCE
learning.posterior_mixture: two-component conditional edge distribution with one global component draw per tournament; edge BCE plus sampled UC expected-F1 utility
learning.neural_parameter_claim: a learned conditional predictive distribution, not an exact Bayesian posterior

posterior.decoder: general F-measure maximizer: optimize empirical expected F1 over cardinalities 1 through n
posterior.certificate_scope: human finite-cohort diagnostics only; formal coverage applies to independent Bernoulli comparisons with fixed counts, not correlated human ballot subsamples

budget.lambda_budget: split the posterior_mixture system allocation equally between its two fixed lambda candidates
charged_components: development inference and Monte Carlo draws
budget.overshoot_policy: fixed 2% upper-allocation tolerance; any overrun flags EQUAL_ALLOCATION_VALID=false; complete and archive as exploratory_budget_deviation with no p-values
budget.early_convergence_policy: a converged scalar empirical-Bayes fit may leave allocation unused; report that cost without padding
budget.inference_cost_policy: held-out inference wall time and draws are separately reported for every system

selection.criterion: mean resample F1 within profile, then mean across development profiles
selection.tie_break: earlier checkpoint, smaller lambda, threshold nearest 0.5, smaller threshold
selection.test_access: prediction functions receive observed counts only; held-out reference labels are used after choices are frozen

reporting.aggregation: mean across resamples and initializations within profile, profiles within source, then six sources equally
reporting.selective_reporting: per-profile descriptive results including exact set and predicted cardinality; no pooled superiority claim
reporting.smoke: software QA only; not a timing pilot or empirical result
reporting.pilot: timing and feasibility only; not a replacement for production

synthetic_certificate_diagnostic.inference_inputs: observed W only; P is generation/evaluation truth
synthetic_certificate_diagnostic.scope: illustrative fixed IID Bernoulli count models; separate from human-profile learning
